# DogsBay XML — Working with the agent

## Working with the agent

- [The agent, and what it may touch](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/overview.md): Compare built-in and hosted agents, learn which tools they receive, and understand the limits on changes to files.
- [Which agent to use](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/choosing.md): Compare the built-in and hosted agents and learn when to run both.
- [Reviewing an agent's changes](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/proposals.md): Review agent edits to DITA files as tracked changes, and accept, reject, or comment on them.
- [Using Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-docs/agent/hosted-agents.md): Run an agent you already use inside the editor and give it access to the editor's DITA tools.
